ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOB$ is a straight angle, $\angle BOC=36^\circ$, $OD$ bisects $\angle AOC$, $\angle DOE=90^\circ$. Find the measure of $\angle AOE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB$ is a straight angle and $\angle BOC=36^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=180^\circ-\angle BOC=180^\circ-36^\circ=144^\circ$.\\
Since $OD$ bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
then $\angle AOD= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\times144^\circ=72^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle DOE=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOE=\angle DOE-\angle AOD=90^\circ-72^\circ=\boxed{18^\circ}$.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: Since $\angle AOB$ is a straight angle and $\angle BOC=36^\circ$, it follows that $\angle AOC=180^\circ-36^\circ=144^\circ$. Since $OD$ bisects $\angle AOC$, $\angle AOD=\frac{1}{2}\times144^\circ=72^\circ$. Since $\angle DOE=90^\circ$, thus $\angle AOE=90^\circ-72^\circ=\boxed{18^\circ}$.

The problem stem also gives that OD bisects ∠AOC, so ∠AOD=144°÷2=72°. Since OA is located inside ∠DOE, and the problem stem gives ∠DOE=90°, therefore ∠DOE=∠DOA+∠AOE. Thus ∠AOE=90°−72°=18°.
